_read_by: scripts/release_gate.py bundle-scan -- docs/RELEASING.md, 'Release markers'. A present marker is a module (in the exe's PYZ) or a name (in our own modules or the entry script) that exists only with the fix it claims; an absent one must never ship. Add one with every CHANGELOG entry that claims a fix, `since` the version that will carry it.

present.claims: the BLAS thread cap that took 1.5 GB of committed memory off every process (1.4.1)

present.name: cap_blas_threads
present.claims: the same cap, by the function that applies it before numpy loads

present.name: WORKER_COMMIT_GB
present.claims: the worker count is bounded by what Windows will let the run commit (1.4.1)

present.name: _rotate_previous
present.claims: the run log is kept as CBBEtoUBE_previous_run.log instead of truncated (1.4.1); defined in the entry script

present.name: pool_error
present.claims: a run whose worker pool broke is reported as such, not as success (1.4.1)
